questions.question: Why is superposition important in Shor’s Algorithm simulation?

answers.a: It allows evaluation of many inputs simultaneously

explanations.a: Superposition enables quantum parallelism by evaluating many values at once.
explanations.b: It does not increase classical memory.

questions.question: In the simulation, what step reveals periodic peaks?

explanations.c: QFT transforms periodicity into measurable peaks.

answers.b: To convert measurement results into the period

explanations.b: Classical processing extracts r from measurement results.

questions.question: Which part of Shor’s Algorithm is quantum?

explanations.c: Period finding using QFT is the quantum part.
explanations.d: Prime listing is not part of the algorithm.
